plumbing.review:
- **[P2] Failed preview posts bypass capacity checks.** [agent.go:244](agent.go:244) now retains full snapshots when checking fails, but [factory.go:1298](factory.go:1298) publishes those snapshots without the successful-preview path’s capacity checks. A failed option containing over 4 MiB of compressible source produces a comment whose marker `DecodeMarker` rejects, losing recoverable state and allowing repeated failure posts. Incompressible snapshots can exceed the comment limit because clipping never removes the marker. Apply both limits to failed preview posts, omit oversized marker payloads while retaining the saved result, and add regression coverage.

The factory reports all required checks passing; the ratified acceptance sources are unchanged.

**Merger work**

- Record the option-preview and cache-policy decision.
- Run pinned TLC coverage: `go test -tags integration ./internal/formalize -run '^TestPreview639PinnedTLC$' -count=1 -timeout 5m`.
- Run the real-image budget check: `INVARIANT_PLUMBING_REAL=1 go test ./internal/plumbing -run '^TestSandboxBudgetAndRealCheckout$' -count=1 -timeout 70m`.

VERDICT: changes needed
